title: Quantization sensitivity matrix and threshold calibration for AWQ/GPTQ int8/int4
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Build a general-purpose sensitivity matrix and automated threshold-calibration pipeline that quantifies quality impact for AWQ and GPTQ conversions (int8 and int4 variants) across representative workloads. Use results to produce tuned thresholds for automated deploy gates and per-model profile recommendations. This ticket covers test harness design, dataset slice selection, metric definitions, and initial implementation of the threshold-search runner plus dashboard hooks for alerting.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible sensitivity matrix can be generated for a given model+quant profile showing delta metrics (e.g., exact-match, rouge, BLEU, perplexity, embedding-similarity) across quantization levels and per-layer perturbations.
Threshold-calibration job outputs a recommended quality threshold (delta tolerance) for each model/profile and stores it as an artifact accessible to the rollout service.
Regression-monitoring pipeline consumes the calibrated thresholds and emits a Pass/Fail signal during staged rollouts; documented gating behaviour for canary/rollbacks.
Initial evaluation run completed for 3 internal models (base-13b, chat-7b, embedding-2b) using both AWQ and GPTQ paths with int8 and int4 profiles.
Dashboard panels added to Console showing sensitivity heatmaps, per-slice failure rates, and historical threshold drift.
Automated alerts configured: notify eng-oncall and product slack channel when a new quantized candidate fails threshold on production-like eval slices.
Performance: calibration job completes within 3x the native model full-eval time for a standard eval set (target runtime constraint for CI integration).
steps: Design eval harness interface (runner accepts model artifact, quant profile, eval set spec, metrics list)
Assemble representative eval slices: chat-conciseness, instruction-following, code-generation, embeddings-semantic, long-context consistency
Implement metric adapters for AWQ/GPTQ outputs (handle deterministic stubs vs stochastic sampling)
Run grid search + local search to produce sensitivity matrix (per-layer, per-block when feasible)
Develop threshold-search policy: choose per-model delta budget, per-slice weighting, and aggregated pass/fail rule
Integrate outputs with rollout service: store threshold artifact, add gating API, wire into canary steps
Expose heatmap and time-series metrics in Console; add run-level links to GH PRs and Confluence run-book
Run initial evaluations on internal infra, capture results, iterate on metric weighting and slice selection
notes: We intentionally prioritize slice-level sensitivity over aggregate single-number delta — some quant errors concentrate on specific capabilities (e.g., math, code) and must be surfaced separately.

AWQ and GPTQ produce different error modes; AWQ tends to perturb logits more in narrow vocab regions while GPTQ noise is sometimes layer-local — sensitivity matrix needs to capture both per-layer and per-block effects.

Empirical observation from prior ad-hoc runs: int4 AWQ on base-13b creates large embedding drift on 'semantic-similarity' slices while int8 is usually safe; include embedding-similarity as a weighted slice.
We will avoid hard-coding metric thresholds per-se but produce recommended thresholds and an explanation artifact describing which slices drove the recommendation.
CI integration plan: run a fast, low-sample calibration job as a pre-merge check; run full calibration as part of nightly model-qualification job.
